expected_items.description: Move beyond embedding Monaco by adding desktop workbench behavior around the editor.
Use runtime workspace files rather than only a static snapshot catalog.
Keep code copy and editing as product functionality with save and backup behavior.
Use a desktop-style workbench with file browser, open editor tabs, command toolbar, and settings popup instead of forcing everything into one flat web screen.
Manage the larger work with durable requirements, specs, tasks, validation, traceability, history, and evaluation files.
Do not solve runtime indexing by scanning private/local-only folders or escaping the workspace boundary.

artifact_checks.purpose: Runtime workspace text file catalog command and boundary controls.
Desktop code workbench UI and Monaco command integration.
Desktop workbench, tab strip, toolbar, diff shell, and settings popup styling.
Build, test, and Browser smoke validation record.
